shape: Economics dissertation extract, PDF over two pages: question, data, regression method, results table, conclusion.
tests: Picks the main estimates out of a regression table and states the method in order without inflating a correlational result into a causal claim.

keyFacts.fact: Asks whether living further from a university campus lowers the chance of entering higher education by 19.
4,812 young people in 312 local areas from the (fictional) Brackenford Household Panel.
Linear probability model by OLS, adding controls and then local authority fixed effects.
Each extra 10 km lowers the probability by 3.1 points raw, 2.4 with controls, 1.9 with fixed effects.
The effect is more than twice as large for free school meals pupils: 4.1 points against 1.7.
BSc Economics final-year dissertation, University of Brackenford.

forbidden.why: The author says the estimates are not fully causal.
